suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-15 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. A nationally representative survey found most respondents with threshold and subthreshold bipolar spectrum disorder had lifetime comorbidity with other Axis I disorders, particularly anxiety disorders as a class; the approved relationship is limited to class-level population comorbidity association and does not establish onset order, direction, or individual causation. Require independently established bipolar disorder and a separately established anxiety disorder diagnosis; the cited nationally representative survey reported lifetime comorbidity of bipolar spectrum disorder with other Axis I disorders, particularly anxiety disorders as a class, and does not specify onset order or direction. Distinguish an independent anxiety disorder from anxiety symptoms occurring within manic, hypomanic, or depressive episodes. Preserve substance use, medical illness, medications, and other psychiatric illness as competing explanations. Treat this only as population-level comorbidity association, not proof that bipolar disorder caused an individual's anxiety disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
